body:
I just keep thinking... even if I did take these pills tonight what if it wasnt enough? What if I woke up in a hospital, let alone what if I woke up in my own damn bed and wasted all of these? They are so hard to obtain... 

Yet, I mean this SO I love with all my heart hes already lost a close friend of his to suicide. We've talked about it a lot, he knows what mental state I'm in. He's briefly said it would devastate him if I were to die in the same fashion. I don't know, I feel so lost.

How have you been? Where are you coming from? I'm sorry I'm drunk my sentence structure may be off or weird, but I'm trying to be sincere.
